title: Global Regulatory & Statutory Open Metadata Index (2024–2026) — 42,085 Official Dossiers Across 40 Jurisdictions
description:
Automated, machine-readable bibliographic metadata catalog (CSV, JSONL, Frictionless Data Package, and complete per-jurisdiction Markdown directories) indexing 42,085 official primary and secondary laws, final and proposed rules, statutory instruments, central bank circulars, supreme audit reports, and multilateral resolutions across 963 government departments, ministries, regulatory agencies, and multilateral organs in 40 active jurisdictions: United States (15,515 dossiers | Catalog), United Kingdom (3,159 dossiers | Catalog), Canada (5,392 dossiers | Catalog), European Union (5,429 dossiers | Catalog), United Nations (7,015 dossiers | Catalog), Ireland (191 dossiers | Catalog), Australia (1,326 dossiers | Catalog), International (1,184 dossiers | Catalog), Switzerland (191 dossiers | Catalog), Finland (67 dossiers | Catalog), France (526 dossiers | Catalog), South Korea (66 dossiers | Catalog), Norway (73 dossiers | Catalog), Italy (79 dossiers | Catalog), Philippines (429 dossiers | Catalog), Poland (43 dossiers | Catalog), South Africa (46 dossiers | Catalog), India (15 dossiers | Catalog), Belgium (107 dossiers | Catalog), Brazil (85 dossiers | Catalog), Japan (93 dossiers | Catalog), Netherlands (36 dossiers | Catalog), Russia (34 dossiers | Catalog), Sweden (49 dossiers | Catalog), Austria (189 dossiers | Catalog), Bahrain (33 dossiers | Catalog), China (41 dossiers | Catalog), Czechia (36 dossiers | Catalog), Germany (152 dossiers | Catalog), Denmark (43 dossiers | Catalog), Estonia (16 dossiers | Catalog), Spain (43 dossiers | Catalog), Israel (139 dossiers | Catalog), Liechtenstein (54 dossiers | Catalog), Lithuania (0 dossiers | Catalog), Portugal (42 dossiers | Catalog), Saudi Arabia (47 dossiers | Catalog), Singapore (82 dossiers | Catalog), Ukraine (1 dossiers | Catalog), Iceland (17 dossiers | Catalog).

Full plain-English executive briefings, structured HTML compliance matrices, semantic definition lists, two-stage Tables of Contents, authority RSS syndication feeds, and unabridged source PDF dossiers are accessible via each record's canonical URL on https://www.indexdata.org, the Complete Issuing Authority Directory, the AI/LLM manifests (llms.txt and llms-full.txt), and Wikidata entity Q142071440.
